title: Bee Gnomes
text: Bee Gnomes. One was really good - one with the beard and bees on him - the other one had some wings that just wouldn't stay up and really looked junky so I only put one out on world honeybee day August 21. They looked knit or coquetted  - standing about 6 or 7" tall.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful. Further, I never accept free products - my reviews are 100% honest and reflect my own personal experience.
